Tooltip: Sends an email using the specified Microsoft oulook 365 mailbox to the configured receipients, with the specified subject, body, and optional CC, and attachments.

Arguments.Name: EmailName
Arguments.Tooltip: The email name used just for logging purposed. Given it with meaning purposed of the email.

Arguments.Name: EmailTo
Arguments.Tooltip:
The email TO received. If there want  multiple TO received then make sure used ';'.

For example: abc@gmail.com; xyz@gmail.com;

Arguments.Name: EmailCc
Arguments.Tooltip:
The email CC. If there is no CC in email just leave it with the default value '-'. If there want  multiple to CC then make sure used ';'.

For example: abc@gmail.com; xyz@gmail.com;

Arguments.Name: EmailAccount
Arguments.Tooltip: Specifies the email address of the target Microsoft 365 mailbox that the application will access during execution and which to interact.

Arguments.Name: EmailBodyMessage
Arguments.Tooltip: Body message of the email that want to be sended.

Arguments.Name: EmailAttachmentCollection
Arguments.Tooltip: List collection of files that want to be attached in send email.

Arguments.Name: TenantID
Arguments.Tooltip: The Microsoft Entra Tenant ID for the Microsoft 365 application. Used together with the Client ID to authenticate and authorize access to Microsoft 365 resources.

Arguments.Name: ClientID
Arguments.Tooltip: Microsoft Entra Application (Client) ID required for Outlook 365 authentication. This value is obtained from the App Registration in Microsoft Entra ID and is used to establish a secure connection to Microsoft 365.

Arguments.Name: OrchestratorFolderPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Specifies the full orchestrator folder path where should access assets orchestrator resources for get the client secret used in microsoft outlook 365. Leave empty to used the current folder.

Arguments.Name: ClientSecretAssetName
Arguments.Tooltip: Specifies the name of the orchestrator credential asset used to retrieve authentication credential for microsoft 365. The asset must exist in the specified orchestrator folder.

Arguments.Name: EnableUIFallback
Arguments.Tooltip: Enables send email with Outlook UI automation as a fallback when the Outlook 365 API method is fails.

Arguments.Name: OutlookAppPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Optional. Specifies the file system path to the Microsoft Outlook application executable used for UI automation when the UI fallback is enabled.

Arguments.Name: TimeoutMicrosoft365
Arguments.Tooltip: The maximum time, in seconds, that the Microsoft 365 scope waits for an authentication before timing out. Increase this value if network latency or service response times are higher than expected. The default value is 60 seconds.

Arguments.Name: ExceptionMessageSendEmail
Arguments.Tooltip: Exception message if send email is failed and thrown an exception.
